channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What’s happening on day 96 of Iran war as US, Iran engage in new attacks
item.description: Rubio says the US will lift sanctions on Iran only if it gives up enriched uranium, rejecting a Hormuz-linked deal.

item.title: Kyiv residents seek shelter during renewed Russian attacks
item.description: Residents in Kyiv took shelter as Russian attacks continued into the daytime hours after overnight strikes.

item.title: Accident on Kuwait motorway as Iranian missiles fly overhead
item.description: Video shows a car accident occurring on a road in Kuwait City as missiles flew overhead.

item.title: US says it attacked Iran’s Qeshm Island; Tehran targets Kuwait, Bahrain
item.description: The US military says it carried out ‘self-defence’ strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island.

item.title: Iran war live: Strikes shut down Kuwait airport with several wounded
item.description: The US military earlier said all Iranian drones and missiles failed to strike their intended targets.

item.title: Rania al‑Abbasi’s children: The truth revealed
item.description: Syrian commission confirms the deaths of Rania al-Abbasi’s six children, missing under Bashar al-Assad’s rule.

item.title: Trump berated Netanyahu? Analysts question US-Israel feud rumours
item.description: Analysts say 'strategic leaks' aim to influence public perceptions amid diplomatic impasse in US-Israel war on Iran.

item.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon but partial truce with Hezbollah appears to hold
item.description: Israel continues its campaign in the south, though has not struck Beirut after a deal announced by the US.

item.title: US and Iran launch new strikes, as Kuwait says airport hit by Iranian drones
item.description: Kuwait says its international airport has been badly damaged by Iranian drones, and traffic is suspended.

item.title: Seven killed after drone hits bus in Russia-controlled part of Ukraine
item.description: The bus was travelling between Moscow and Simferopol, in Russian-occupied Crimea, an official says.
